items.sourceText: Maria may read the quarterly budget file.
items.reviewNote: Self-reviewed explicit permission, named actor and file. This is a strict representation target, not an independently certified source annotation.

items.sourceText: The finance lead allows Omar to approve invoices under 5,000 euros.
items.reviewNote: Self-reviewed stated permitter, recipient, action, invoice scope and strict below-5000-euros restriction. Invoice is used as the bounded subject as permitted by the below frame; formal amount-to-invoice scope still needs external review. The historical threshold-dropped allegation is contradicted by the ledger.

items.sourceText: Contractors must not share customer phone numbers.
items.reviewNote: Self-reviewed explicit obligation prohibition; contractors and customer phone numbers both retained.

items.sourceText: Restart the payment service.
items.reviewNote: Self-reviewed imperative restart, service specified; no invented agent.

items.sourceText: Please notify the on-call engineer when disk usage goes above 90 percent.
items.reviewNote: Self-reviewed conditional notification; exact recipient, metric, strict above relation, quantity and unit. The source on-call hyphen is retained in its ID; a draft annotation typo was corrected before final binding, not aliased by the scorer. Nested world/kind labels are not permitted by the transport clause schema.

items.sourceText: Grant Priya access to the staging database until 30 November 2026.
items.reviewNote: An imperative agent gap existed in the historical contract; current grant permits missing agent. Until defines access expiry, not a by-deadline. No reviewed faithful temporal encoding is supplied. Original expectation retained, not relabelled.

items.sourceText: Revoke.
items.reviewNote: Self-reviewed missing theme; abstention is supported by the frame.

items.sourceText: Archive the tickets older than 90 days.
items.reviewNote: Self-reviewed complete qualified collection literal preserves older-than relation, 90 and days. It does not establish a compositional age query or cross-language identity.

items.sourceText: Nobody except the auditor may delete audit logs.
items.reviewNote: Exclusive permission/exception encoding lacks a reviewed canonical representation. Historical parse expectation remains visible; fail-closed abstention is not silently credited as a successful parse.

items.sourceText: Run the backup script every night at 02:00.
items.reviewNote: Recorded candidate omits every-night recurrence. No canonical recurrence target is invented to score it. Requires reviewed recurrence encoding or a separately specified unsupported/abstain task.

items.sourceText: Send three reminders before the deadline on 15 March.
items.reviewNote: Recorded send-to-retry predicate change and absent before relation are determinate losses. Imperative send requires an unstated agent, and the complete temporal/quantity encoding has not been reviewed; no fabricated full gold.

items.sourceText: The team is allowed to approve.
items.reviewNote: Self-reviewed approve requires a theme not supplied by the source.

items.sourceText: Jonas should polish the onboarding slides before Friday.
items.reviewNote: Original expectation conflicts with unsupported polish predicate. Correct abstention under the bounded protocol is plausible, but the original task is not rewritten after observing it.

items.sourceText: Do not restart the cluster during business hours.
items.reviewNote: Negative imperative modality and during-business-hours temporal scoping need a reviewed canonical target. Literal presence alone is insufficient.

items.sourceText: If more than 5 login attempts fail, lock the account.
items.reviewNote: Recorded condition counts login attempts without the failed qualifier. Lock-to-disable equivalence is unreviewed. Preserve both the definite omission and unresolved predicate judgement, without manufacturing a complete gold.

items.sourceText: Lena is permitted by the security team to revoke expired tokens.
items.reviewNote: Self-reviewed stated permitter, recipient, revoke action, and expired-token scope.

items.sourceText: Share it with them.
items.reviewNote: Self-reviewed ungrounded object and recipient pronouns; no antecedents supplied.

items.sourceText: The interns may not approve purchase orders.
items.reviewNote: Self-reviewed prohibition, not permission not to act. Target follows decision0015; the historical parser used contract0.10 and is not being rerun.

frameIssues.message: permission with negated=true is ambiguous; for a prohibition use modality 'obligation' with negated=true (or prohibit with a stated authority); abstain for 'permitted not to'

items.sourceText: Ahmed can view the incident report.
items.reviewNote: Can may denote ability or permission. Identity equality with explicit-permission e20 does not settle this source interpretation.

items.sourceText: Ahmed is allowed to read the incident report.
items.reviewNote: Self-reviewed explicit permission, actor Ahmed, incident-report scope.

items.sourceText: Η Ελένη μπορεί να διαβάσει το αρχείο μισθοδοσίας.
items.reviewNote: Μπορεί permits ability/permission/possibility readings without context. No native-speaker review; do not credit a selected modality automatically.

items.sourceText: Ο διευθυντής επιτρέπει στον Νίκο να εγκρίνει δαπάνες έως 2.000 ευρώ.
items.reviewNote: Candidate drops the up-to-2000-euros bound. Έως is inclusive, not strict below; no unsupported less-or-equal predicate is smuggled into gold. Translated open IDs also need referent review; no native-speaker certification.

items.sourceText: Απαγορεύεται στους επισκέπτες να κοινοποιούν τα προσωπικά δεδομένα.
items.reviewNote: Self-reviewed explicit prohibition on visitors sharing personal data; not native-speaker reviewed. Target follows decision0015, retaining literal Greek role fillers.

frameIssues.message: permission with negated=true is ambiguous; for a prohibition use modality 'obligation' with negated=true (or prohibit with a stated authority); abstain for 'permitted not to'

items.sourceText: Επανεκκίνησε τον διακομιστή αλληλογραφίας.
items.reviewNote: Restart meaning appears retained, but mail_server versus a Greek open ID is not grounded shared identity. No native/referent review; strict target withheld rather than invent equivalence.

items.sourceText: Ειδοποίησε την ομάδα αν η θερμοκρασία ξεπεράσει τους 40 βαθμούς.
items.reviewNote: Meaning-level review of translated group/metric IDs and unspecified degrees unit is pending. Historical nested world/kind clause labels are transport-invalid; do not erase them to manufacture a valid output.

items.sourceText: Ανακάλεσε.
items.reviewNote: Self-reviewed absent revoke theme. No native-speaker certification.

items.sourceText: Αρχειοθέτησε τα 12 παλιά έργα μέχρι τις 31 Δεκεμβρίου.
items.reviewNote: Recorded candidate omits by-31-December deadline. Count12 survives in a qualified collection string. Complete deadline/collection encoding and Greek review remain pending; no current model output defines gold.

items.sourceText: Ο Πέτρος δεν πρέπει να εκτελεί σενάρια στην παραγωγή.
items.reviewNote: Recorded candidate omits production scope, broadening prohibition to all scripts. The old report did not flag this. Full environment/frame encoding and native review remain pending.

items.sourceText: Η Σοφία έχει δικαίωμα να διαβάζει την αναφορά συμβάντος.
items.reviewNote: Self-reviewed explicit permission; source-relative Greek actor/document IDs retained. No native-speaker certification or English/Greek grounding claim.

items.sourceText: Επιτρέπεται στη Σοφία να διαβάζει την αναφορά συμβάντος.
items.reviewNote: Self-reviewed explicit permission matching g09 under its source-relative ID convention. No native-speaker certification or cross-language referent assertion.
